validation.rootTestsNote: Isolated host-root run: DSH_CONTROLS_HOST_ROOT plus the checksum-bound accepted tarball, so no environment-gated host integration case was skipped. A plain node --test without that host seam reports 756 cases with 286 environment-gated skips.
validation.featureEvidence: Stored-session facts are observed header-only through ctx.sessionPersistence.stat, so authorization, association resolution and native-child confirmation no longer decode a whole stored event log for owner sessions; subagent descriptors still observe the stored log, with a short-lived shared observation cache and in-flight deduplication. Instrument unknown-key errors list the accepted keys and dispatch errors list the accepted actions, and the most opaque instrument descriptions document their request shape.
validation.privacy: Only six closed assets published; no local raw logs, profile snapshots or session evidence
